title: Unit Event — The Way I Played That Day — Episode6 Soft Memories, Hard Realities

meta.Event: The Way I Played That Day
meta.Event Outline: Kanade continues to write songs in the hope of saving Mafuyu. When her grandmother calls to suggest that she think more about herself and her own future, her thoughts turn toward the past.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That was the first song I ever composed.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: After that, I started composing more songs while receiving advice from my dad.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Like what kind of songs would make both my parents smile...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
And what would make them feel happy...
I wanted to compose those kinds of songs.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You must really love your mom and dad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My mom always knew how to make me feel better... If I ever felt scared or worried she'd give me a hug, and she always sang lullabies to me whenever it was bedtime...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
My dad was also really nice...
He always praised me and gave me pats on the head.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Whenever we were all together, everything felt so warm and happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They'd always smile whenever I composed a new song...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Which always puts a smile on my face...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I understand now that music means everything to you, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Music was always a part of our lives in some way... And that's what made us happy.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Which is why I love music so much...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Is something wrong?
You don't look so good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I should head back...
I need to finish working on that song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Because my goal is still to compose songs that can save people...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm okay, and I'm sorry for making you worry...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you for listening.
I feel a little better now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll come back once our song's finished...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I didn't know that's why she's composing these songs.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Which is likely striking a chord with Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She clearly tried to suppress whatever she was feeling just now...
